batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c FY Fazal b SR Watson

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c SK Warne b AP Dole

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b SK Trivedi

batting.name: RS Bopara
batting.dismissal: run out (AA Jhunjhunwala, FY Fazal, NV Ojha)

batting.name: PP Chawla
batting.dismissal: c AA Jhunjhunwala b SK Trivedi

batting.name: MJ Lumb
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b RS Bopara

balls.text: slower ball outside off, hits it straight down the ground, between long-on and long-off, comes back for two, superb finish for Rajasthan
picks the slower ball, pulls it over midwicket, but the sweeper on the leg side is straight and gets around
backs away to pull this ball, but straight to deep square leg for one
quicker bouncer and he beats him on the pull, can't even get a leg-bye
gets too much under a slower ball and Jhunjhunwala comes in from long-on to take a simple catch
length ball on the pads, placed wide of deep square leg for two
hits powerfully, but gets neither elevation nor placement, just a single down to long-on
dragged from outside off to drive to long-on for a single
full delivery, driven straight, not powerfully but between long-off and long-on
swats a length delivery down to long-on
bouncer this time, is too late into the pull, but this one is not called wide - clearly too high
this time Watson is too close to him as he looks to cut over point
misses out on a short and wide delivery, has made too much room here, called wide - harsh call
stays slow, Chawla looks to drive over extra cover, mistimes and gets a single to sweeper-cover
gets the inside half of the bat as he looks to drive down the ground, gets a single to long-on
continues with the slower ones, driven down to long-off for one
slower short ball, pulled away well this time, straight to fine leg
quicker short one this time, pulled in front of square, not the best timing, and that allows him to steal the second
slower short ball on the pads, and he manages to find Watson at short fine, who in turn misses the direct hit
another slower delivery, pushed down to long-off, Chawla retains strike - good over, just two off
slower ball, and Chawla still can't get it away, hits it straight to point
thrown up wide, Chawla looks for the expansive drive and connects nothing
sharper short delivery, 133ks, Chawla drops his wrists and gets out of the way
short ball, pulled away in front of square, gets a single
back of a length, on off, no room, punched to point
full, on the pads, driven down to long-on for another single
on the pads, helped around the corner
short on the pads, worked away for one
pushed down to long-off for one

big big misunderstanding! Irfan punches it past extra cover, and sees Jhunjhunwala run in fast from sweeper-cover and decides against the two, but Bopara wants it, and runs all the way down while Pathan has not even moved out his crease. Not much calling or signalling visible there. Irfan's hand came up in a NO right away but Bopara paid no heed and kept charging down
starts with a length delivery, which costs him just a single
IKP gives him the charge again, Warne drags it short, and Pathan pulls it smack between deep square leg and deep midwicket
beats Bopara in the flight and then gets a thick edge with the legbreak, but it lands safe
back of a length, pushed down to long-on
swept away from the leg-stump line for one
comes down the track, find he is not quite to the pitch off the ball, and slogs, the inside edge hits the pad and goes down towards long-off
back of a length, pushed down to long-off for one
back of a length, punched down to long-off, Dole's spell is done
tries the bouncer, pulled down into the ground, gets a single
worked away off the pads for a single
full delivery, hit to mid-on for a single
length ball, around off, no room, hit back to the bowler
back of a length, width, punched away to sweeper-cover for one
shorter, into the pads, flicked away uppishly towards midwicket for one
slower bouncer, Bopara makes a late move to try and hit it over the keeper, but too late
slower legcutter, way too wide outside off
just back of a length, outside off, hit back to the bowler
this time he flicks it away for a single to fine leg
on the pads, and bunted away but the square leg is up close
length ball, angling across, hit one bounce to short extra cover
full outside off, defended back to the bowler

what an over, what a guy Warne is! Opposition going at 10 an over and he has a slip, a wide one, in the 12th over! Mahela looks to work it from outside off into the leg side, gets a leading edge and Warne swallows it at the wide slip
short ball, pulled away to deep fine for one
big big wicket! short and wide, and Yuvraj's eyes light up as he goes for the pull, but he gets a bottom edge onto the stumps
shaping to flick it over short fine, but it is too wide and he pushes it down to long-on
and Mahela plays another graceful shot, makes room, takes a full and wide delivery and drives it to the left of point and right of third man
poor delivery, long hop on the pads, and Yuvi is no mood to miss out on those today, past square leg
looks to run this to third man, but hits straight to point
slider, defended off the back foot
and one more, Yuvi on fire here, jumps out of the track, Warne throws it wide and that gives him enough room to swing his arms and he goes perfectly straight, into the sight screen
flat flat six! Almost parallel to the ground, the orthodox sweep shot, from around off, and it never seemed to have left the ground
low full toss on the pads, worked away for a single
late-cut, almost from in front of stumps, but the short third man is fine
angled into the pads and he fails to make contact looking to help it away for one
worked away off the pads for a single
fired into the pads, defended
dropped by Dole at square leg, and it's an absolute sitter, hit down his lap, and it goes in and comes out
fired down the leg side, and Mahela helps it away past short fine, easy does it

well bowled, slow, flighted, Mahela waits and waits before turning his wrists but he is still early into it, and the leading edge almost carries to Warnie. A younger man would have taken this in front of him, he had enough time to go down
shorter and flatter, pushed down to long-on for one
Yuviiii! tossed up in his area, Yuvraj slog-sweeps him, clean over midwicket
bunted into the leg side for one
flighted on the pads, and superbly swept, very fine, gets four for it, just guiding it fine of fine leg
some turn there, but short and wide, and Yuvi cuts it against the spin, gets a single
too far down the leg side, Ojha gets hand on ti, else it would have been five wides
pushed down to long-on for a single
shorter, on the pads, glanced away for one
tossed up slightly, defended off the front foot
paddled away to wide of short fine for one
full on the pads, and worked away for an easy single
full and flat, pushed down to long-on for one
short ball tried, Yuvi dugs under it without trouble
slower ball, steered away, down to third man for one
short and wide and Mahela gives it the treatment, cutting him over point
looks to run this down to third man, but doesn't get the placement right
pushed down to mid-on to get off the mark

and Sanga perishes trying to hit the first ball from a new bowler for four. He does that often in Twenty20, and tried it here again, jumped out of the crease, looked to go over midwicket, but didn't get enough height in it, and Pathan timed his jump to perfection to hold onto this overhead catch
cut away from in front of off stump, but straight to point
on the pads, pushed away for a single
Sanga! lovely straight loft, clears the front leg, gets on a knee and goes back over the bowler
looks for the big sweep over short fine again, steals a leg-bye as he misses
tip and run, to midwicket
flicked away off the pads, square of deep fine leg for two
full and wide down the leg side
looks to create room to cut here, but it is too close to his body and beats him
back of a length, punched wide of mid-off for one
full, on the pads, flicked away, but straight to square leg
looks for a drive but the length is not there, and he ends up hitting to extra cover where Faiz misfields to let a single
nothing fortuitous about this, makes room, and sends a full delivery crashing past point, and square enough of third man
what a leading edge! the middle of the leading edge as he looks to flick it over short fine, but the leading edge carries over third man for six
runs this down to third man for one
slower ball this time, and Mahela gets an inside edge that is safe - much better over from Watto
length ball, just outside off, beats Mahela as he looks to run it down to third man
sharp bouncer, and Bisla is caught pulling from the front foot, and this time the top edge lobs straight to square leg
now he has worked up some pace, short delivery at 135ks, beats Mahela but they sneak a leg-bye to Warne who fields and tries an underarm flick like Jonty Rhodes in ultra slow motion
length ball outside off, Mahela ends up dragging it to midwicket
fast, 102ks, but it also stops at him a touch, and Bisla can't play a forceful shot to it
makes room and cuts, finds Warne at extra cover
worked away off the pads for one
looks to go inside-out this time, but there is hardly any air on it, and is beaten by slight extra bounce
lovely sweep shot, knows there is just one short fine to clear, and he deliberately plays it in the air and behind square
flat delivery, outside off, punched to point
another full and wide delivery, nicely driven, but straight to extra cover
length ball, pushed down to mid-off
more ordinary fielding (dare I say so?), lame short delivery, pulled down the ground, Trivedi from mid=on gets around but doesn't get down in time
misfielded by Raut at midwicket, just let it through, didn't get down in time, and lets through two runs
tries a bouncer, 125ks, almost pitched it at his feet but the ball hardly gets chest high, Bisla gets out of the line
full, wide, gentle pace, 127ks, poor loosener, and Bisla drives it past point
short of a length, and again he mis-hits an attempted flick over the leg side, but it lands short of mid-on
a gift down the leg side, and he glances it without any fuss for four
Ojha shouts for a catch down the leg side, Umpire Tarapore says wide - replays inconclusive - perilously close to the glove
worked away off the pads for a single he can take blindfolded
wide down the leg side
looks for the hit over midwicket, but the mis-hit bisects mid-off and mid-on
quicker, sharper, higher, 135ks, and Bisla gets a perfect top edge over the keeper's head
tries the bouncer, not much bounce on offer, 130ks, Bisla sways out the line
lovely delivery, short, making him fend, getting an edge, and wide enough of keeper. Match over
beats him with a sharp bouncer and gets a dot
and oversteps and scores are level
YKP strikes back, with a pulled six! Is expecting a short ball again, his first movement is back and he just gets stuck into the shot
short ball, beats him on the pull, and gets him in the solar plexus
width there, driven on the up, gets a single
tucks him up with one angling into the ribs
full on off, crisply driven, but straight to extra cover
diving save from Sreesanth at midwicket, saves at least one run
on the pads, and he drops and runs
pushed to sweeper-cover for another single
into the pads, worked away for a single
back of a length, no room, pushed back to the bowler
comes down the track this time, Chawla drags it short and he defends
another straight delivery, and another forward defensive
slider, and Ojha defends it off the front foot
lovely inside-out shot, always good to watch, overpitched and wide and he just times it over extra cover
short and wide, cut away, gets it wide of deep point
flighted around off, hit back to the bowler
there is the power of Pathan, drags a length ball from outside off and over cow corner and into the crowd. Rajasthan's net run-rate is going to get a big boost
on the pads, bowler is lucky he has found short fine leg
short, and he late-cuts it past short third man
Bisla is so excited at a clean take wide and full that he appeals, but it is killed by a quick signal for a wide
full ball outside off, driven powerfully to sweeper-cover
short ball, way down the leg side
angled into the pads, gets a leg-bye
yorker as he looks to charge at him, gets a single to midwicket
googly, appeal for lbw, but it has struck him outside the line of off
finally some good fielding by Punab! Ojha comes down the wicket and drives wide of long-off, where Mahela puts in the dive and saves two runs
looks for the big drive outside off and is beaten
stays back and punches a fullish delivery square of the wicket
short and wide, cut away to deep point
deftly worked away off the pads for a single
full here, driven straight to cover
hits the first ball he faces down the ground for a single
punched away to sweeper-cover for one

and the dbbly-dobblies strike, too late perhaps! slower ball, Lumb looks for his flick shot over midwicket, but because the ball is slower he ends up dragging it squarer and to a waiting Chawla. Misses out on a century
short again, punched to short cover
short and wide, helped away for one to short third
Up comes the keeper, and through goes a bottom edge between his legs! Guess when it's not your day, it's not your evening either

no respect for Irfan here, walks down the pitch again, and flicks him over midwicket, just a chip shot! He does not feel there is any risk involved in walking down to him, and strange to see the keeper has not come up
slower ball, beats him outside off
pick-up shot, nearly drop-kicks it, walks down again, gets a leg-side half-volley, and flicks it over short fine
his best shot of the day, walks down the pitch, and drives on the up, inside-out, past extra cover
length ball, pushed down the ground for one
beats him with a googly again, he is not reading them, but this time he stays in the crease
Lumb gets stuck into them some more! Takes half a step down the pitch, and then sweeps a flighted delivery over midwicket. Clean hit again
back of a length, punched down to long-off
swept away for one to deep square
beats him with a googly, but Bisla is too slow in removing the bails and Lumb drags his foot back just in time, half a frame there
short ball, cut away for one to sweeper-cover
full delivery, driven inside-out to sweeper-cover
reverse-sweep again, and Bisla displays his cricketing knowledge by appealing for an lbw when it has come right off the middle of the bat
and some more, orthodox sweep this time, lands between the two fielders on the leg side, and Mahela gets a hand on it but it still goes for four
reverse-sweeps, from in front of stumps, past short third, Lumb is running away
length ball, pushed down to long-on for one
short, on the pads, pulled away for a single
beats him with a non-spinning delivery, Bisla shouts unnecessarily for lbw, Chawla is not even interested, he knows it is sliding down
looks to cut a fullish delivery, but hits it straight to short third
worked away with the spin, comes through for the single that gets him to his fifty
swpet away fron in front of stumps, and deliberately in the air, over short fine - the dugout thinks it's his fifty, but he is on 49
back of a length, hit back to the bowler

Punjab is back to being a Comedy of Errors! For a change Rajasthan make a mistake, Lumb ignores Ojha's calls of NO and keeps coming down for a single. Bisla, who fields the ball not far from the striker's end, is not aware to the situation and throws to the non-striker's end. And it would still have been close had the throw been not wide! And Mahela, who has run in from slip to striker's end, keeps waiting for the throw in vain
nicely flighted, pitched outside leg, turning towards off, defended
flighted around middle and leg, and gently pushed down to long-on
full toss, just a punch wide of extra cover, and the timing carries it for four
clean loft, over mid-off, waited for the ball to arrive, it landed close enough to him to play the big straight shot
flighted outside off, played with an open face towards short third
poor thinking/bowling - no one behind square on the leg side and he bowls leg-stump again, and Lumb cashes in again
very well played, he pre-meditates a pull, expecting a shorter one, but the ball is still fullish, but his arms move fast, bat comes down fast, and he gets four runs to fine leg
shot! length ball, Lumb likes the gentle pace, gets under it and lofts him over long-on
tips and run to the leg side for a single
fuller this time, he gets a thick edge for a single
short and wide, and crashed away over cover, it's all too easy as of now for Lumb
short into the body, bunted down to midwicket

full and wide again, and has been lofted over point. And Sreesanth applauses the batsman sarcastically, and then he claps for the umpire too - wasn't happy with any of the no-ball calls, which were marginal ones
and over-steps again! beats him with a full and wide delivery, but he has slightly overstepped again
and over-steps while bowling the short one, which is pulled on the bounce to mid-on
short-arm pull, short delivery, rocks back and murders it square

overpitched on the pads, worked away past midwicket, Sanga chases it and wants to relay the throw to Chawla while off balance, but Chawla is too close to him, and he ends up throwing wide and giving away an extra run
back of a length, punched away to third man
slashes outside off but it is too wide
half-volley on offstump, crunched down the ground, Yuvraj makes a diving save at mid-off

that's lucky, shapes to charge at him, ends up staying back, and leading-edges an attempted flick, over mid-off. Irfan has completely misjudged it mid-off, he comes charging in, and is lobbed. Would have been a chance had he stayed his ground or gone back a bit
flatter outside off, 86ks, punched away to point
sweeps again, from in front of leg, to short fine
takes this on the full and executes the sweep ball very well, beating the man deep on the leg side
beauty! turn, bounce, grip, and flighted nicely too, outside leg it pitches, 76ks, and beats him outside off
creates gap right away, flighted, turning in, and Ojha takes a single to mid-on
pitches it up, gets some swing, Lumb looks to drive down the ground, gets the inside half of the bat towards mid-on
there comes the poor delivery, short, 130ks, and Lumb jumps into it and pulls it over midwicket
139ks shaping in from back of a length, played to midwicket
swing again, shaping in towards off, defended back to him
poor fielding again! gets a thick edge on this, and Powar at third man is slow in getting down on a straightforward take, and lets it go through for four
no swing this time, and it keeps going with the angle, and is a wide
hint of swing, 135ks, beats him outside off, Lumb plays at it outside the line
